Team — forwarding Helio's request. TL;DR: customer is asking 35% off + 2-year exclusivity (sector language) in exchange for a co-branded PR + case study. They included redline clauses that, if accepted, give them a fairly broad "exclusive partner" statement and long-term rights to use our logo as well.

Why I'm escalating: Legal flagged the exclusivity language as atypical and marketing needs to approve the PR wording. Aditya and I think we can close if we offer: 30% year-1 discount, a 6-month non-exclusive case study + co-branded press release with pre-approved quote, and a $10k co-marketing credit. We would insist on a clause that the customer cannot represent exclusivity beyond the agreed 6 months and that any press release is jointly approved.

Requested approvals:
- Vivek: OK to concede to 30% (not 35%) and allow the co-marketing credit?
- Marissa: marketing sign-off on the public language and the 6-month, non-exclusive window?
- Legal: we need to confirm legal can convert the redline exclusivity into a time-bounded, verifiable clause (I attached the redline for review).

Attachments: redline_sow_helio.pdf

Thanks — can we get replies on this thread so we have a single record for the decision?

—Connor

Connor — thanks for pulling this together. From Marketing's perspective:

- We are happy to do a co-branded press release and a short site case study (one page, headline + 2 paragraph quote) provided the customer removes the unrestricted exclusivity statement. We can accept a 6-month language-limited reference that calls out the pilot scope ("HelioMetrics and Redwood will co-market the pilot program for six months").
- We will require final sign-off on the quote and the press release; we will not allow the customer to use the Redwood logo with additional claims beyond what we approve.
- We support the $10k co-marketing credit (covers paid placements + design) as long as it is tied to an approved press timeline (90 days from go-live).

If Leadership approves the 30% discount and the $10k credit, Marketing will draft the PR and a sample quote for legal review and for Helio to approve.

Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
